svg.title: Prompting techniques: demonstrations and persona are separate choices
svg.desc: Panel A compares three prompts for the same late package ticket. The available queue labels are KITE, MOSS, and LAMP. Zero-shot gives no worked examples. One-shot maps a billing ticket to KITE. Few-shot also maps a delivery ticket to MOSS and a sign-in ticket to LAMP. The expected label is MOSS. Panel B asks both prompts which API pattern supports phone and browser clients with different needs and asks for one operational trade-off. The persona prompt adds the role of a mobile developer. Both prompts give zero worked examples.

text.tspan: Examples and roles change different parts of a prompt
Two comparisons. Change one ingredient at a time.
A
Compare the number of worked examples
Keep the held-out question, choices, and output format identical.
New support ticket
My package was supposed to arrive yesterday, but it has not arrived.
Route the support ticket. Reply with one queue label: KITE, MOSS, or LAMP.
Prompt variant
Worked Q → A examples included before that question
Zero-shot
0 examples
No worked question–answer pairs.
One-shot
1 example
Q: I was charged twice for one order. → A: KITE
Few-shot
3 examples
Q: I was charged twice for one order. → A: KITE
Q: The courier left my parcel at the wrong address. → A: MOSS
Q: I cannot sign in after resetting my password. → A: LAMP
Expected queue is MOSS. The delivery example shows the desk’s convention.
B
Compare a neutral prompt with a persona
ShopEasy has phone and browser clients that need different tailored APIs. Which pattern fits?
Choices: Bulkhead · API gateway · BFF
Both prompts ask for one operational trade-off in two short sentences.
Neutral · no role
No persona instruction is added.
Persona · one role
You are a mobile developer.
0 demonstrations in either prompt. Only the role instruction changes.
A persona can change emphasis; it does not guarantee expertise or correctness.
Zero-shot still has instructions. Shots count worked input → output demonstrations, not requests.
